violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed no approved splitter attached to mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. PIC disconnected no approved splitter from mop sink faucet during inspection.

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Posted in Conspicuous Location
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. EHS observed the 2025 permit in the office space.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. UPON DISCUSSION WITH PIC, OWNERSHIP TOOK DOWN THE PAPER PERMIT THIS MORNING TO GET FRAMED. PIC WILL FRAME AND POST THE 2025 PERMIT TODAY.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed no hand soap at the hand washing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO REFILL HAND SOAP DISPENSER.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: large bulk bin of sugar.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC LABELED THE BULK BIN OF SUGAR. FOR BEST PRACTICE, LABEL ALL WORKING CONTAINERS - SHAKERS, SQUEEZE BOTTLES, BINS, ETC. - WITH ITS CONTENTS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS observed a cardboard box of chips being directly on the floor under a shelf of chips.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EHS INSTRUCTED STAFF TO MOVE THE BOX OF CHIPS OFF OF THE FLOOR AND ONTO A SHELF.

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: EHS observed mold inside the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC ABOUT CLEANING THE ICE MACHINE ROUTINELY. PIC STATES THAT ICE MACHINE WILL BE PROFESSIONALLY CLEANED IN MARCH.
